gsal byed kyis thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu byed/ dbyangs gsal phan tshun sbyar ba las ming tshig dang / ngag gi tshogs rnams rim gyis brgyud do/ brgyan pa'i don ka'i srog tu a yig zhugs pa nyid yin/ sde tshan gsum pa'i lnga pa ni ṇa yin la/ cung zad ra yi zhon pa ni/ ṇa yis steng du brgyan pa ste/ de ltar na gong gi ka dang lhan cig sbyar bas kahā/ a zhes bya bar 'gyur zhing / don de nyid thugs la bzhugs nas/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa ngor chen kun dga' bzang pos dril bu rim lnga'i rgyud 'debs su yang / rgyal bas lung bstan nag po spyod pa ba/ zhes gsungs so/ /de la spyir 'phags pa'i yul du grub chen nag po ba'i ming can la/ barba pa'i slob ma la/ shar phyogs nag po par grags pa ral pa can lnga brgya'i nang nas rjes su 'brangs pa da lta yang tshe'i rig 'dzin bsnyes nas lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la bzhugs par grags pa de dang / brtul zhugs nag po spyod pa'i rdo rje nyid dang /lo tsā ba 'gos khug pa lha btsas kyi bla mar gyur pa nag po dam tshig rdo rjer grags pa kye rdor nag po lugs kyi skor gyi gzhung phal mo che mdzad mkhan de dang / slob dpon de'i yang slob mar grags pa nag po shan+ta bha dra dang / grub chen ka la kā pa ste nag po yun chen du grags pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lam srol mdzad pa de rnams las 'dir brtul zhugs nag po zhabs nyid yin la/ slob dpon 'dis ni shrī dza lan dha ra'i zhabs dang / grub lam 'bras brgyud pa'i a wa bhu ti yin/ tshogs gnyis pas bcu gnyis brgyud pa las 'byung ngo / /yon po srong ba'i brgyud pa las 'byung ngo / /kye rdo rje 'tsho skyes kyi brgyud pa las 'byung / chen a wa bhu ti kha dang / u tsi tā chi ba med pa dang / lha lcam lak+ṣi ka ra dang / mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo la sogs pa'i grub thob pho mo de rnams bsten cing mdzad pa'i rnam thar dkyus ltar la slob ma'i mchog phyag rgya chen po grub pa gu h+ya pa ste/

yul nyi shu rtsa bzhir brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa rang dang mnyam par skyong nus pa bzang po'i zhabs dang / sku lus 'di nyid kyis zung 'jug rdo rje sku mngon du mdzad pa/ ku su lu skal ldan du grags shing / mtshan dngos rgya gar grub thob tshem bu pa dang / grub thob kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba bram ze dpal 'dzin dang / rgyal po rol pa'i zla ba/ slob dpon dge ba'i mgon po la sogs rgyun du'ang rnal 'byor pho mo bdun cu don gnyis tsam re zhabs 'bring du 'khod skad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid las/ lung la yid ni ches pa dang / de bzhin gzhan la yid ches dang / /de bzhin bla ma la yid ches/ /zhes pa'i don la/ lung la yid ches sgrub pa/ gzhung gi dngos bstan la dang por 'byung yang / 'chad pa'i tshe mjug tu rgyud sde'i go rim ni/ bla ma las thos nas yid ches pa dang / rnal 'byor pa nyams myong can gyi rgyud don paṇ+ḍi tas stobs las 'byung ba'i bstan bcos la yid ches pa dang / de'i don myong ba'i tshul gyis skyes pa'i rang gi sems la sgro bskur med par yid ches pa dang / de dag kyang ston pa rdo rje 'chang nyid kyi gsungs pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud nyid dang zung ldan du sbyar nas mchog tu yid ches par sgrub pa'o/ /yid ches bzhi la yang / bla ma nyid yid ches kyi mchog tu gyur pa yin te/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid las/ yid ches rnams ni thams cad la/ /bla ma nyid ni byed por 'gro/ /zhes dang / de yi yi ge'i nang nas oṃ/ /phyugs nang ri dgas seṅge mtshungs/ /rig byed nang nas nges brjod dang / /me tog sa ra wi ra mtshungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de yang gser gyi dpes bstan te/ bsreg dang bcad dang brdar ba yis/ /mkhas pa dag ni gser bzhin du/ /yid ches rnam pa bzhi yis ni/ /lhan cig skyes pa brtan par bzung / /zhes gsungs la/ de la yid ches bzhi ni gong ltar yin la gser gyi dpe ni bsregs bcad brdar ba gsum gyi sgo nas yid ches bzhi po thams cad la sbyor/

bla ma la gnyis te/ rgyu lus dag pa'i slob dpon dang / 'bras bu sems kyi slob dpon no/ /de yang gsang ba'i de kho na nyid las/ bla ma rnam pa gnyis su nges te/ rgyu 'bras 'byung bar bstan pa'o/ /zhes dang / dkyil 'khor slob dpon ngo bo yis/ /phyi dang bcas pa'i nang na bzhugs/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i bla ma gnyis la ma bsten par gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu mi 'grub pas/ dang po bla ma la mos gus tshud tshud sgom du gzhug pa ste/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid las/ mkhas pa dngos grub du ma ni/ /de yi bka' drin dag gis thob/ /bla ma dag gis ma gtor par/ /zegs ma tsam yang 'grub mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'di'i skabs su slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar gyi lung yang bya zhing / gzhung drug spyi'i bsdus don yang bshad do/ /de nas gzhung re re la yang bsdus pa'i don re re ste sa bcad drug yin la/ tshig don re re ste 'grel pa drug yod cing / sbyin sreg gi 'grel pa gnyis kyang 'byung ngo / /gzhung don ni mchan bus rtogs par 'gyur la/ de yang dang por dkyil chog la gong du bshad pa ltar/ bsdus don tshig don gzhung don gsum gyis 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gzhung gi mchan gyis rtogs par nus shing / ras bris kyis phyogs dang lag len rgyas par tshig don gyis 'chad do/ /'di'i skabs su dbang ni mngon par rtogs pa bdun dang ldan pa nyid nges par ding sang rtsod ldan gyi gang zag gi smin byed du dgos tshul/ dbang nyid la yang 'di nyid kyi khyad par gyi chos thun mong ma yin pa'i brtul zhugs rim pa bcu bzhi nyid tshang ba'i byed chos ji ltar yin tshul dbang la gnas pas dam tshig dang sdom pa ji ltar bsrung tshul rnams zhib tu 'chad cing / dam tshig las spyi'i dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ khyad par gyi dam tshig brgyad sogs dang / de dag kyang / dang por bsrung tshul bar du bsten tshul/

mthar dam tshig nyid lam du 'gro tshul rnams gzhung dang sbyar la zhib tu 'chad do/ /de bzhin du sgrub thabs la yang bsdus don sogs gsum las tshig don skabs su bdag gis byas pa'i/ rnam bshad dang bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab mthong ba don rnams kyi nang ldan ltar mtha' chod par bya zhing / bskyed rim go don sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul sems 'dzin rnams legs par tshang bar bya/ sbyin sreg gi skabs su bsdus don dang / tshig don gnyis las gzhung don las/ phyi nang gsang gsum du phye ba'i dang po la zhi rgyas dbang drag sogs dang / gnyis pa la dus rgyun gyi bza' ba'i rnal 'byor dang / khyad par gyi bza' ba'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo gnyis bstan zhing / dang po sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin dang / gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i skabs ltar 'chad do/ /gsum pa ni/ las rgya'i rnal 'byor dang / dpyid thig ltar rlung las su rung ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ rtsa ba'i rgyu las gsungs pa ltar bsten tshul zhib tu bshad do/ /de dag gis ni bskyed rim gzhung gsum bstan la/ bslab bya'i rim gnyis rdzogs pa'i rim pa la/ dang po gsang ba'i de kho na nyid kyi sems kyi rang bzhin gsal stong zung 'jug tu gtan la dbab cing / de nyid la 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad tshang bar ngo sprad la/ yid ches khyad par can nam skyes skyes bsgom du gzhug cing / bsdus don sogs gsum gyis rgyas par 'chad par byed do/ /pha rgyud dang thun mong du zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /gnyis pa o la pa tis phyi nang gi chos thams cad mtshon bya dang mtshon byed kyi tshul du sbyar nas 'khor 'das ro gcig tu gtan la dbab cing / de nyid la nges pa'i shes pa khyad par can nam skyes skyes su sgom du gzhug gong ltar bsdus don tshig don gzhung don gsum gyi sgo nas kye rdo rje sogs dang mthun pa 'khor 'das dbyer med du ston pa'o/

/gsum pa ni dpyid thig la bsdus don sogs gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas lam rim gnyis nyams su blangs pa las sa bcu bgrod tshul dang / yang dag par bcos ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / bsgom bya kun spang par bstan tshul rnal 'byor pa nang la mchog tu gzhol bas/ phyi rol gyi lha dang sngags sogs las rab 'byams thams cad kyang bde lag tu sgrub tshul kun kyang zhib tu ngo sprad cing / sku gsum gyi gtum mo bca' ba lus kyi gnas rnams dang / gsung gi gtum mo rtsa yi ge'i rnal 'byor thams cad 'di dang gong gi o la gnyis kyis gsal bar ston cing / khyad par rlung gi rnal 'byor/ phra thig dang bcas pa gsal bar 'di gnyis dang / rtsa ba'i rgyud las 'byung la/ bsam mi khyab la brten te phyag rgya chen po'i don rnams gsang ba'i de kho na nyid las ston no/ /de ltar na gzhung drug gi mchan dang / gzhung drug mdzad pa po slob dpon gyi rnam thar la sogs pa'i yig sna bco lnga po 'di rnams rje sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa la nag 'bum zhes yongs su grags so/ /nag 'bum gyi mchan 'di rnams rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa yin gsungs so/ /de nas rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i rim pa lam du slong bar grags pa'i yig sna bzhi 'byung ba'i/ yig sna gnyis pa de nyid dmigs rim dngos yin pas de thob nas nyams khrid du skyong dgos shing / yig sna gsum pa de rim pa bzhi'i mtshan don yin pas dang por 'chad cing / yig sna bzhi pa 'di shes bya rgyud kyi rim pas gsal byed du sbyor zhing de dag gi skabs su go don bogs 'don gegs sel nyams kyi skye tshul kun lam slong rang gis gsal bar 'chad pa yin la/ 'di dag gi mchan 'di rnams ni rgyal ba brag phug mchan sna thung ba rtse mo dang ring ba sa paṇa nyid pa'i gsung bgros ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pas mdzad pa yin no/ /grub mtha' ma snyogs na 'da' kha'i rnal 'byor dang /

gzhan 'chi srid bar do rnams lam bslong gi dbu ltar ro/ /de la nang don myong ba lhan skyes kyi yi ge med pa'i tshul du shar ba'i gang zag de la dang po chos kyi phyag rgya gtum mo tsaṇ+ḍa li'i 'khor lo bzhi ldan gyi myong ba skyes shing / rlung gi rnal 'byor la nus pa thob na las rgya'i rnal 'byor 'chad/ de la las rgya'i mtshan nyid dang / brtag tshul dang / bsten tshul rnams ni rtsa ba'i rgyud ltar 'chad dgos shing / bsten tshul dngos ni 'du shes gsum ldan sogs dkyil chog gi dbang gsum pa dang / sbyin sreg gi gsang ba'i sbyin sreg sogs kyis cung zad 'chad la/ gtso dam dmigs pa 'phrul 'khor rdzas sogs lo chung lugs gsungs bor bla ma'i ngag las ston no/ /de ltar yang las kyi phyag rgya rigs ldan la pho nya'i rnal 'byor ram chos kyi phyag rgya gtum mo 'khor lo rigs ldan bsten nas nas shar ba'i lta ba spyod byed med pa'i de nyid la nang sngags lugs kyi phyag rgya chen po yang zer zhing 'di ni nyams su myong med kyi tshul gyis rgyud la 'char ba yin no/ /sngags gsang ba'i de kho na nyid bstan pa'i gnyug ma ye shes kyi rang zhal mtha' bzhi dang bral bar bstan pa de la ni rtogs bya'i lta ba zhes kyang ming thob la/ phyi phar phyin theg pa dang rjes su 'brel ba'i lhag mthong shes rab chen pos sgrub pa'i de kho na nyid ces zer ro/ /de ltar gzhi dam tshig dang ldan zhing / lam bslab bya rim pa gnyis la legs par bslabs pa'i rnal 'byor pa de nyid 'bras bu la spyod par byed pa'i mtshams sbyor ni spyod pa yin la/ de la gnyis su byed na gsang spyod tshogs spyod dang / gsum du byed na spros bcas dang / spros med dang / shin tu spros med do/ /de la phyi ltar bshad na/ dang po spros bcas kyi rgyan he ru ka'i chas rnams ni dkyil chog na gsal bar bshad cing /

spros med kyi spyod pa'i rten mtshan ldan gyi rnal 'byor ma dang 'grogs tshul ngag brda' dang / lag pa'i brda'/ 'du ba'i gnas sam bgrod par bya ba'i yul/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ yul chen sum cu rtsa bdun sogs ni rtsa ba'i rgyud nyid na gsal bar bshad la/ de ltar na rnal 'byor pa'i nyams su myong ba'i rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / phyi rol zhing skyes ḍ+wa ki ma'i byin rlabs la brten nas phyi rol tu gnas chen rnams su brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad pas na rdo rje lus kyi rtsa mdud rnams grol nas rlung sems rnams nang gi rtsa gnas rnams su thim pas sa bcu rim gyis bgrod tshul rnams ni gong gi dpyid thig skabs su sbyar nas 'chad dgos shing / 'bras bu sku'i gnas tshul rnams ba'i de kho na nyid las gsal bar gsungs te/ thog ma tha ma la sogs rab tu dbye ba spangs shing dpe med kun 'gro nam mkha'i dngos/ /zhes pas chos sku bstan la/ bsod nams ye shes bdag nyid sbyor ba gnyis kas rnam bkras rang gi rang bzhin shar gang yin/ /zhes pas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku bstan cing / rgyal ba khyu mchog cis pas sprul pa'i sku bstan tu/ /slar yang de dag thams cad kyi rgyab rten du 'grel pa la ma brten pa'i rgyud kyang man ngag gi bshad pa mtha' chod par bya ste/ sbyin bya dbang gi gnas skabs su yang phan yon dang nyes dmigs sogs dang / bslab bya rim gnyis las bskyed pa'i rim pa'i skabs su ba lang lha sogs dang dus min 'chi las rnam rgyal sogs sbas pa brda'i skad kyis bstan tshul dang sngags btu sogs dang / rdzogs rim la yang gsang ba mchog gis dges pa na sogs kyis spyir bstan tshul/ gtor ma sbyin sreg sngags btu sogs nges don du rdzogs rim ston byed rnams dang / grogs spyod pa'i rten phyag rgya bsten tshul pho nya'i lam dngos gsang bar gdams pa dang bcas pa rnams dang /

'bras bu yang chos kyi sku yi lus can gyi sogs kyis bstan cing grub pa'i mtha' tshe 'dir rkyen dbang gis ma snyogs na/ 'da' kha ma yang rnal 'byor pa rnams 'pho ba'i tshe sogs kyis bstan tshul rnams zhib tu bla ma mkhas pa man ngag gi gnad dang ldan pa'i ngag las rtogs par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di chos rje rdo rje 'chang dang / mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i gsung rgyun las 'ongs pa'i legs bshad rjes 'jug mkhas pa tshad ldan dag gis zin bris su bkod pa las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bshad zin te/ 'phros pa'i don yang bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ zab mo'i yang rtse 'khor lo bde mchog gi /rtsa rgyud don 'grel khog phub 'di bshad pas/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs dgongs rab rdzogs nas/ /bdag gi rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug gyur cig 1 /rgyud la 'jug pa'i khog phub legs bshad mig /rgyud don gling bzhi gsal ba 'di med na/ /rgyud mchog 'di la 'chad nyan byed 'dod kyang / /rgyud kyi phra rags tshig rnams gang gi blta/ 2 /rnam dpyod bzo sbyang mkhas pas legs bsgrubs pa'i/ /lung rigs rlung dar rtog dpyod zag lhan can/ /bla ma'i legs bshad gru chen 'di med na/ /rgyud 'grel yid bzhin rgya mtshor gang gis 'jug 3 /skye bar sbyangs pa'i skyes stobs rta ljang can/ /thos bsam me shel 'bar ba'i srid pa'i mig /kho bo'i rnam dpyod 'od stong ma shar na/ /gong ma'i dgongs don 'dab brgya gang gis 'dzum/ 4/'di na rgyu don smra mkhas 'ga' yod na/ /legs bshad rin chen 'phreng ba spel legs pos/ /blo gsal mgrin pa mdzes par gyis shig dang / /gzu bo'i blo yis legs so cis mi ster/ 5 /kha cig rang gi blo gros dmus long yang / /gzhan gyi blo gros mdzes pa'i bzhin bzang por/ /phrag dog tsher ma rnon pos rgyud dkrugs nas/ /zug rngus lto khengs ngan smra'i gshang gci 'dzag 6 /ga ye rgyud don legs bshad don gnyer ba'i/

/gzur gnas blo gsal 'ga' dang 'ga' yod na/ /legs bshad khog phub me long 'dir ltos dang / /gong ma'i dgongs don mtshar po'i bzhin gyis tshim/ 7 /ding sang bza' btung kho na don gnyer las/ /chos la mi sems skal ngan rnams kyi ngor/ /legs par bshad 'di wa skyes bkres po'i mdun/ /rtsa sngon phang phung spungs bzhin gyur du dogs/ /de lta na yang rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /yab chos snying po bde mchog rgyud bshad rgyun/ /'chad par nye ba blo yis ma bzod nas/ /nyin dang mtshan du 'bad pa chen pos sbyar/ /'di bgyis dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro kun gyi/ /bcas dang rang bzhin sdig sgrib kun byang nas/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med dbang po gsal/ /bsam pa'i bya ba ma lus mthar phyin shog 10 /nam zhig 'tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /bla ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs kyis/ /bdag cag slob mar bcas pa'i mdun bsus nas/ /mkha' spyod gnas su yud kyis 'khrid par shog 11 /de nas bde ba can dang mngon dga' sogs/ /dag pa'i zhing du so so'i mgon po yi/ /zhal mthong gsung thos rang rgyud smin grol gyis/ /sa lam myur bgrod spangs rtogs mthar phyin shog 12 /slar yang gang la gang 'dul sprul pa yis/ /sna tshogs thabs mkhas du mas srid mtha'i bar/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rin chen 'di/ /rab tu 'phel zhing yun du gnas gyur cig 13 /ces dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi don 'grel khog phub legs par bshad pa bde mchog rgyud bshad bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di yang / snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs sras rgyal tshab dam pa/ 'jam mgon grub pa'i khyu mchog bsod nams dbang po'i zhal snga nas dang / rgyal sras sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ rigs rnams kun gyi khyab bdag rje btsun mus pa chen po 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan te yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/

dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud bshad zab mo'i rgyun 'chad du nye ba 'di/ bdag gis byas pa'i don 'grel khog phub 'di la brten nas cung zad mi nub cing dar ba'i rkyen du gyur na ci ma rung snyams pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas bslangs ste/ mi shes bzhin du spyi brtol bskyed nas rigs kyi bu ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug la sogs te rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i slob ma'i tshogs rnams la phan par bsams nas/ rang gi bgrang bzhi bcu phrag lnga dang nyag ma gcig tu bslebs pa thams cad 'dul gyi lo/ rgyal gyi zla ba'i dmar cha dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes la bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ gso ba rig pa sogs rig gnas kyi bye brag du mar blo gros dbang kyi snang ba rab tu rgyas pas/ legs bshad du ma'i mgrin pa can/ gdong dga' pa bsam pa don chen mgo dkar bas dad gus chen po'i sgo nas bgyis so/ /'dir 'bad dge bas bla ma he ru ka /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams rab dges nas/ /bdag cag dpon slob tshe 'di 'phos ma thag /dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par shog /de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ/ dharme u da ya mastu/ thams cad bkra shis/ chos 'di dar bar gyur cigam̐/ ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi don 'grel khog phub bde mchog rgyud bshad/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
